name: ultimate-accelerator
description: Apex Legends companion app for tracking Battle Pass Challenges

paragraphs: Ultimate Accelerator is a companion application for Respawn Entertainment's video game Apex Legends. In Apex Legends, the Battle Pass is a system that rewards players for accruing stars and "leveling up" their Battle Pass. Players can unlock character cosmetics and in-game currency by advancing their Battle Pass levels. Battle Pass levels increase when the player has accrued enough stars to "level up." Players earn stars by completing daily, weekly, and/or event challenges. This full stack application was designed as my capstone project for App Academy's 24-week Full Stack Software…
features: Battle Pass Challenges are based on play modes, playable characters (legends), or weapons and challenge types. I analyzed relevant raw data from Apex Legends in order to programmatically identify, categorize, and create…
Almost all text on the app has a contrast ratio of at least 7.00 and is sized in rem units.
